# CRIS Maastricht University

> A comprehensive research information system showcasing scholarly publications and projects across law, economics, healthcare, and technology at Maastricht University.

CRIS (Current Research Information System) at Maastricht University aggregates academic outputs from faculty across multiple disciplines, with particular strength in European law, public law, tax law, and cross-border employment studies. The repository emphasizes research from the Faculty of Law and Graduate School of Business and Economics, reflecting the institution's research priorities in EU integration, constitutional law, and transnational governance.

## Key Topics

- European Union Law
- Dutch Constitutional Law
- Cross-Border Employment
- Public Law
- Tax Law
- Game Theory
- Social Security
- Judicial Review
- Fundamental Rights
- Transnational Work
- Higher Education
- Medical Ethics
- Bariatric Surgery
- Maastricht Centre for European Law
- Dutch Legislation

## European and Constitutional Law

- [The Dutch Constitution as Cinderella: belittled by the make of the constitution](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/de-grondwet-als-assepoester-klein-gehouden-door-de-grondwetgever): Heringa examines Dutch constitutional law, judicial review, and EU integration
- [De rechtsstaat in de grondwet maar nog steeds niet voor kinderen](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/de-rechtsstaat-in-de-grondwet-maar-nog-steeds-niet-voor-kinderen): Willems on rule of law and children's rights in Dutch constitutional law
- [Het combineren van werkzaamheden over de grenzen heen en hoe onbelangrijke werkzaamheden toch belangrijk kunnen zijn](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/het-combineren-van-werkzaamheden-over-de-grenzen-heen-en-hoe-onbe): E.C. van Ooij's analysis of cross-border employment and marginal work under EU law
- [Une réforme légale du licenciement économique aux Pays-Bas, source d'incertitude](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/une-r%C3%A9forme-l%C3%A9gale-du-licenciement-%C3%A9conomique-aux-pays-bas-source): Gundt on Dutch economic dismissal law reform and employment security
- [What's yours is mine until death do us part? Over de vervolgingsuitsluiting van vermogensdelicten binnen het huwelijk](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/whats-yours-is-mine-until-death-do-us-part-over-de-vervolgingsuit): Van der Aa on spousal immunity and property crime prosecution in Dutch law

## Tax Law and Financial Reporting

- [Formeel belastingrecht, bespreking van het gelijknamige boek van M.W.C. Feteris](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/formeel-belastingrecht-bespreking-van-het-gelijknamige-boek-van-m): Niessen's book review of formal Dutch tax law by Feteris
- [Steuererermäßigung bei ausländischen Einkünften (§ 34c EStG), part 6](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/steuererma%CC%88%C3%9Figung-bei-ausl%C3%A4ndischen-eink%C3%BCnften-34c-estg-part-6-e-e): Prokisch on German foreign income tax relief and international taxation
- [IFRSs vereisen cultuuromslag](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/ifrss-vereisen-cultuuromslag): Vergoossen on IFRS implementation and cultural change in financial reporting

## Economics and Game Theory

- [Stable Sets in Matching Problems with Coalitional Sovereignty and Path Dominance](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/stable-sets-in-matching-problems-with-coalitional-sovereignty-and-2): Herings et al. on game theory, matching theory, and coalitional games
- [Repeated Games with Switching Costs: Stationary vs History Independent Strategies](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/repeated-games-with-switching-costs-stationary-vs-history-indepen): Tsodikovich et al. on game theory, switching costs, and stochastic games
- [Belangrijkste uitkomsten jaarrapportage 2004, A+O Metalektro, Leidschendam](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/belangrijkste-uitkomsten-jaarrapportage-2004-ao-metalektro-leidsc): De Grip et al.'s 2004 annual report on metalektro labor market trends

## Healthcare and Medical Research

- [Implications of Metabolic and Bariatric Operations on Nutrient Absorption](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/implications-of-metabolic-and-bariatric-operations-on-nutrient-ab): Greve et al. on bariatric surgery outcomes and nutritional deficiency management
- [CXCL4L1 inhibits angiogenesis and induces undirected endothelial cell migration without affecting endothelial cell proliferation and monocyte recruitment](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/cxcl4l1-inhibits-angiogenesis-and-induces-undirected-endothelial-): Cardiovascular research on CXCL4L1 chemokine and endothelial cell behavior
- [Adherence to oral anticancer agents: Healthcare providers' perceptions, beliefs and shared decision making in Belgium and the Netherlands](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/adherence-to-oral-anticancer-agents-healthcare-providers-percepti): Verbrugghe et al. on medication adherence and shared decision-making in oncology
- [Selectie voor de ic is beter dan loten](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/selectie-voor-de-ic-is-beter-dan-loten): Pierik's opinion piece on medical ethics and intensive care resource allocation

## Critical Studies and Social Analysis

- [Colonialism Reiterated: The Racialised Division of Labour in Higher Education and Beyond](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/colonialism-reiterated-the-racialised-division-of-labour-in-highe): Critical analysis of racialized labor and decolonization in higher education
- [Shaping children's consumer identity within contemporary Dutch market(ing) practices](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/shaping-childrens-consumer-identity-within-contemporary-dutch-mar): Sprenkels and van der Ploeg on children's consumer identity in Dutch marketing
- [Indonesia's Environmental Management Act of 1997: Comprehensive and Integraded?](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/indonesias-environmental-management-act-of-1997-comprehensive-and): Niessen and Bedner analyze Indonesia's 1997 environmental management legislation

## Innovation and Technology

- [Service robots: rising or falling stars?](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/projects/service-robots-rising-or-falling-stars): Research project on service robots in healthcare and hospitality during COVID-19
- [Flipping the Classroom: revolutionizing Business Education by means of virtual worlds](https://cris.maastrichtuniversity.nl/en/publications/flipping-the-classroom-revolutionizing-business-education-by-mean): Noteborn and Carbonell on innovative business education using virtual worlds
